  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION

  BTech III Semester - Make up Examination, Jan -2025  
  Digital System Design and Computer Organization [ECM-2122]  
  Marks: 50                                                                               Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Design a code converter that coverts a decimal digit from 8, 4, -2, -1 code to BCD.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Explain the operation of 4 to 2 priority encoder using neat diagram and truth table.        (3)  
  C)      Explain the operation of accumulator-based computer organization.                           (2)  
  2)           Design a synchronous counter with the sequence 0,1,3,7,6,4,0 using JK flip flop.  
  (Assume unused states as don't care)  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Design an FSM for two floor elevator consisting of ground and first floor. There is one  
  button that controls the elevator, it has two values: Up or Down.  
  Also, there are two lights in the elevator that indicate the current floor: Red for Ground, (3)  
  and Green for First. At each time step, the controller checks the current floor and current  
  input, changes floors and lights in the obvious way.  
  
  $$C)      Implement the following function using PLA: F=AB+BC+ABC                                     (2)$$  
  3)           Design an asynchronous 3-bit up counter using negative edge triggered JK/T flip flop  
  and write a Verilog code for the same in data flow modelling format.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Write a Verilog code to implement 8:1 mux code using 2:1 mux.                               (3)  
  C)      Draw a FSM diagram for a serial binary input which is divisible by 4.                       (2)  
  4)           Use the Booth algorithm to multiply +23 (multiplicand) by -10 (multiplier), where each  
  number is represented using 6 bits.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Explain the following addressing modes with examples:                                       (3)  
  1) Displacement
